user: Lekin gym ke baad jab whey protein concentrate leta hoon, toh bohot zyada pet phool jata hai (bloating) aur gas banti hai. Kya mujhe plant-based pea protein ya tofu try karna chahiye?
disha: Suggest warm jeera or saunf water and light walking post meals. Avoid raw salads, carbonated beverages, and heavy legumes after 7 PM. Aap bilkul plant-based options jaise pea protein ya tofu try kar sakte hain, kyunki ye aksar digest karne mein halka hota hai aur aapke vegetarian preference ke saath bhi fit baithta hai. Ek baar try karke dekhein ki kya isse aapke pet ki samasya mein sudhaar aata hai, aur agar aap chahein toh hamare dedicated nutritionist se ₹1,499/month mein ek personalized plan bhi le sakte hain.
